en.name: NearServe
en.subtitle: Book a local pro
en.description:
NearServe is a directory of local service providers you can actually book from.

FIND
Browse by category or search, and see who is available today. Each provider has a profile with what they do, their reviews, and their star rating.

BOOK
Pick a slot inside the provider's booking window, tell them what you need, and get an estimate before you commit. Providers who are not taking bookings say so up front instead of wasting your time.

AFTER
Your bookings live in one place. Leave a review when the work is done.

SAVED
Keep the providers you would use again. Everything stays on your device until you book.

review_information.notes:
No account and no sign-in. The five tabs (Browse, Search, Bookings, Saved, Settings) all work from first launch.

This build has no directory endpoint configured, so it runs entirely on the bundled sample directory and needs no network. The businesses are invented and set in a fictional town called Sampleton: every card and profile carries a SAMPLE badge, each list shows a banner saying the listings are not real businesses, and Settings names the active source. That is the offline mode behaving as designed, not a failed fetch.

To exercise booking: open a provider from Browse or Search, start a booking, pick a day within the next 14 days and a free slot, choose the service and the job size, read the estimate (a range, not a quote) and confirm. The booking appears in the Bookings tab with a notice stating that no provider has been contacted and nobody is expecting you. Reschedule and Cancel are available there. "Leave a review" appears only after a booking's end time has passed, because the app marks past appointments complete when it loads, so a slot booked for tomorrow will show Reschedule and Cancel instead of a review button.

A provider profile has a phone row that hands off to the dialler; the sample numbers are fictional, so a call will not connect. Bookings, saved providers, theme and language are stored on the device only, and Settings > "Delete everything on this device" clears them. No ads, no in-app purchase, no third-party tracking.
